generator.convention: Sub-observer point: the line from the Moon's centre to the observer, the Moon at its apparent place (light-time and aberration, SPICE LT+S), its orientation at the emission time. Sub-solar point: the Sun's apparent direction seen from the Moon at the emission time. Position angle: of the lunar north pole projected on the sky at the Moon's apparent direction, true equator and equinox of date, north through east. Selenographic longitude east-positive, (-180, 180].
generator.description: The Moon's orientation (libration, sub-solar point, position angle of the axis) from Skyfield with JPL's DE440 lunar orientation, mean Earth/polar axis frame MOON_ME_DE440_ME421.
generator.frame_check: moon_de440_250416.tf's own example (Earth relative to the Moon at 2022 SEP 30 TDB, geometric) is reproduced to 1 mm in MOON_ME and MOON_PA by this Skyfield setup.
generator.never_a_runtime_dependency: Generated by tools/reference/ (Python + Skyfield). CONVENTIONS section 11: never regenerate a fixture from Rust output.

timescale.delta_t_source: Skyfield's bundled skyfield/data/iers.npz, a daily Delta-T table built from the IERS finals2000A.all series at the time the Skyfield wheel was released. Outside the table Skyfield extrapolates with its long-term Delta-T model (Morrison & Stephenson / Espenak & Meeus).
timescale.dut1_definition: DUT1 = UT1 - UTC = 32.184 + Delta_AT - Delta_T, as Skyfield derives it
timescale.leap_second_table: bundled in the same iers.npz; latest offset 37 s from 2017-01-01
timescale.warning_dut1: CONVENTIONS section 6 assumes DUT1 = 0. Skyfield does not: every GHA in these fixtures uses Skyfield's UT1. The per-epoch dut1_s is recorded, and gha_deg_dut1_zero gives the same GHA recomputed with UT1 = UTC so a DUT1 = 0 implementation has a directly comparable number. 1 s of DUT1 = 15.0410686 arcsec of GHA. Beyond the Delta-T table's end the extrapolated Delta-T implies |DUT1| far above the 0.9 s that real leap seconds enforce (about -3.5 s at 2055), so gha_deg alone is not a physically meaningful prediction for far-future epochs; gha_deg_dut1_zero is.

generator.tolerance_justification: EXPANSION_PLAN P8: libration within 0.05 degrees of Skyfield.
generator.ut1: observer_cases: UT1 = UTC exactly (load.timescale(delta_t = 32.184 + TAI-UTC) per leap-second era), so the Earth's rotation carries DUT1 = 0 as the explorer does. frame_cases are in TT and need no UT1.

meeus_53a.source: Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms, 2nd ed. (1998), example 53.a: the Moon on 1992 April 12 at 0h TD (JDE 2448724.5), the printed results
